cases.input: Run headless. intent=create, slug=insulens. Input: InsuLens claims-triage web app for mid-market insurers. Capabilities: prioritized triage queue, auto-categorization, adjuster routing. Constraint: triage only, no payments (non-goal: payment processing). Success: adjuster triages 50 claims/hour. Distill into the five-field kernel (Why, Capabilities, Constraints, Non-goals, Success signal) plus a JSON status block.
rubric: distills the five-field kernel with intent+success capabilities
names payments as an explicit non-goal
ends with a JSON status block (intent/status fields)
